justification:
Both depict low-relief robed standing figures in file with long vertically pleated garments, hands holding upright shafts, set above a horizontal band of rosette discs 
template that is a fairly specific combination rather than a generic one. The biggest difference in depicted content is scope: A shows a whole architectural terrace scene with columns, staircases and a lion-attacking-bull group, while B shows only an isolated detail of one or two figures' torsos, arms and the rosette band, with no animal combat or architecture visible.
